items.title: 68251_Teddy McRae oral history interview
items.q: We played the Grand Terrace while Earl was out.

ctx.x: Earl Hines was there at the same time.

Yeah. Earl Hines was on tour. We played the Grand Terrace while Earl was out. And we stayed there for about four weeks. And we played -- we came back (to (inaudible)) -- We worked our way back into New York and played the Roseland Ballroom. Then we went to the Famous Door right after the Roseland Ballroom.
